name: fld_isSquare_five_zmod_iff
statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hp5 : p ≠ 5) : IsSquare (5 : ZMod p) ↔ p % 5 = 1 ∨ p % 5 = 4
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hp5 : p ≠ 5), IsSquare (5 : ZMod p) ↔ p % 5 = 1 ∨ p % 5 = 4
informal: 5 is a quadratic residue mod a prime p ≠ 2, 5 iff p ≡ ±1 (mod 5) — since 5 ≡ 1 mod 4, ZMod.exists_sq_eq_prime_iff_of_mod_four_eq_one gives IsSquare (5 : ZMod p) ↔ IsSquare (p : ZMod 5), and the nonzero squares mod 5 are 1 and 4. (Makes the hypotheses of Mathlib2.bld4_pisano_prime_dvd_pred_of_isSquare_five checkable.)
type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], p ≠ 2 → p ≠ 5 → (IsSquare 5 ↔ p % 5 = 1 ∨ p % 5 = 4)
